KP03-P14-code.name: KP03-P14-code
KP03-P14-code.text:
```python
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[1,3],[5,7],[3,1],[7,5]])
mean = X.mean(axis=0); Xc = X - mean
lam, U = np.linalg.eigh(Xc.T @ Xc / 4)
lam, U = lam[::-1], U[:, ::-1]
Z = Xc @ U
Xhat = Z[:, :1] @ U[:, :1].T + mean
```

KP03-P17-ref-body-1.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-1
KP03-P17-ref-body-1.text: KLT uses population C; sample PCA estimates C. Maximize successive orthogonal unit-direction variances.

KP03-P17-ref-body-3.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-3
KP03-P17-ref-body-3.text: $\hat x=\mu+U_mz;\ \overline E=\sum_{j>m}\lambda_j$; orthogonal linear projections and corresponding affine reconstruction.

KP03-P17-ref-body-4.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-4
KP03-P17-ref-body-4.text: $R_m=\sum_{j\le m}\lambda_j/\sum_j\lambda_j$; multiply n−1 spectral losses by (n−1)/n for mean loss.

KP03-P17-ref-body-5.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-5
KP03-P17-ref-body-5.text: Diagonal covariance means uncorrelated; joint Gaussianity additionally implies independence.

KP03-P17-ref-body-6.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-6
KP03-P17-ref-body-6.text: $h=\frac12\log(2\pi e\lambda),\ \lambda>0$; natural logarithm; not an arbitrary-distribution result.

KP03-P17-ref-body-7.name: KP03-P17-ref-body-7
KP03-P17-ref-body-7.text: $\operatorname{rank}(X_c)\le\min(d,n-1)$; repeated roots may leave axes nonunique. Check scale, estimation and labels. Source A03.
